## Implementation Plan Created

### 📋 **3 Phases with 6 Subtasks**

|----|--------|-------|---------|

| 1.3 | Referrer-Policy | strict-origin-when-cross-origin | Control referrer information |
| 1.4 | Permissions-Policy | (restricted features) | Disable unused browser APIs |
